propositions: When multiple findings across successive review passes share one root cause (unenumerated population members), the author receives instance-level fixes but no signal that the method itself is faulty, extending the review cycle unnecessarily.

A new plan-review coaching move 15 must reframe a named instance as a sample from a population and require a machine-checkable completeness proof, scoped via applies_when to criteria where a population genuinely exists (G1G2, E4, G6, A1).

The new move's template must carry exactly one {subject} placeholder and state that the author should enumerate the whole population by distinct pattern occurrences, then add a machine-checkable acceptance criterion that fails while any instance remains.

The change must be addition-only to MOVE_REGISTRY, with no id/name/template/applies_when modifications to existing moves and no changes to the review kernel, code-review registry, or cross-pass detection machinery.
